effects.lua_implementation: EnableReviveLimit and aux.AddSynchroProcedure require exactly one Tuner and one non-Tuner.

official_references.matched_structure: Standard one-Tuner plus one-or-more non-Tuner Synchro procedure; the CCG maximum is narrowed to one non-Tuner.

effects.printed_clause: For this card's Synchro Summon, you can use Gravinity Monster Cards in your Spell & Trap Zone as material.
effects.lua_implementation: Lapsix's distributed extra-material value now accepts only Lapsix and Galaxix as destination Synchro Monsters, matching the two cards that print this permission.

official_references.matched_structure: EFFECT_EXTRA_SYNCHRO_MATERIAL makes a card outside ordinary controlled material rules usable for a Synchro Summon.
Destination-filtered extra Synchro material plus material-use registration.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: EFFECT_EXTRA_SYNCHRO_MATERIAL is evaluated on the material with the destination Synchro card, so the predicate must encode the granting destination text precisely.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is Synchro Summoned, or Special Summoned from your Spell & Trap Zone: Take 1 Level 6 or lower Gravinity monster from GY or banishment, and either Special Summon it or place it face-up in a Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed Special Summon trigger checks SUMMON_TYPE_SYNCHRO or previous LOCATION_SZONE, selects a face-up-eligible Level 6-or-lower Gravinity from GY/banishment, then offers Special Summon or MoveToField+Continuous-Trap type according to current zone availability.

official_references.matched_structure: Places a GY/banished monster in the Spell & Trap Zone as a face-up Continuous Trap.
Offers alternative destinations for one selected card.

effects.printed_clause: During either player's turn, if this card is a Continuous Trap: You can draw 1 card, then you can Special Summon this card.
effects.lua_implementation: A free-chain Quick Effect in LOCATION_SZONE requires Trap type and ability to draw. Resolution draws one, then optionally Special Summons the related handler if a zone and summon legality remain.

official_references.matched_structure: Draw followed by an optional subsequent operation.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of Gravinity Lapsix once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The summon-triggered choice and Continuous-Trap Quick Effect use id and id+100 hard once-per-turn keys.

official_references.matched_structure: Separate hard once-per-turn summon and Continuous-Trap effects.

coverage_override.reason: Five records cover Synchro materials, SZONE material permission, summon recovery choice, trap draw/summon effect, and per-effect HOPT.
